description: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that deliver to, or offer pickup near, a US location. Returns restaurant_id, cuisines, distance when a street address is given, Yelp rating when one is on file, and the restaurant page URL. Ask for a ZIP code, city and state, or street address before calling if you do not already have it.

location.description: ZIP code, 'City, ST', or a full US street address (best: gives distances).

query.description: Cuisine, dish or restaurant name, e.g. 'thai', 'pizza', 'pad see ew'. Omit for everything nearby.

name: search_restaurants
title: Find restaurants
